rules.description: terminal: [1]+arrows for history search and word movement
terminal: Fn+Left/Right moves to the start/end of the command line
terminal: Shift+Fn+Left/Right scrolls to the top/bottom
editing: [1]+Fn+Backspace deletes the next word in browsers
editing: [1]+Fn+Left/Right moves to the document start/end in browsers and Sublime
window: [3]/[4]+Backtick cycles windows of the current application
fkeys: Fn+F1 opens the Help menu
